_comment: Discovery source queries for scripts/curation-discover.sh (Slice 5, specs/marketplace-curation-engine). MONTHLY, model-using, budget-capped (EF-012) — distinct from the nightly LLM-free rot-watch. Each query is a GitHub search/repositories qualifier string over a covered domain; results are scored (trust + safety, LLM-free) then judged (advice-neutrality + fit, LLM) before being PROPOSED for maintainer review. Proposal only — never auto-added (observe-never-install). Periodic + targeted (clarification 3): covered domains + known channels (skills.sh, vendor orgs).
